title: A harvest lot, as its holder counted and weighed it. Slot 0 (harvestLot.plantsHarvested): plants harvested into this lot, a whole number. Slot 1 (harvestLot.wetWeightGrams): fresh weight at harvest, whole plants as cut, in whole grams. Slot 2 (harvestLot.dryWeightGrams): dry weight of the lot as stored, in whole grams. The numbers are the holder's own statement; nobody measured them for the holder. Which lot, from which batch and of what is in the record the numbers are sealed with, not here. Published by VeilCore (veilcore.org).
